title: Levels of the tower direct image
statement:
For $g:T\to S$, define
$g_\bullet^*:\operatorname{Tow}(S,\mathcal O_E)\to\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ and
$g_{*,\bullet}:\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)\to\operatorname{Tow}(S,\mathcal O_E)$
levelwise ([sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]); the first is exact, and
$Rg_{*,\bullet}:D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))\to D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(S,\mathcal O_E))$
is the derived functor of the second. Then for
$C_\bullet\in D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$,

$$
\bigl(Rg_{*,\bullet}C_\bullet\bigr)_n\simeq Rg_{*,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}C_n
\quad\text{in }D^+(S_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^n).
$$

proof.text: Use the recorded Grothendieck abelian structure of coefficient towers. The product-site direct image preserves arbitrary limits: the underlying presheaf functor computes them sectionwise, restriction of scalars preserves limits, and the full subcategory of levelwise sheaves is closed under limits. The Grothendieck adjoint functor theorem supplies its left adjoint.

For each level use the exact evaluation right adjoints. The ordinary right-extension/pushforward comparison of lem-sp-tower-push-right-extension identifies the two composite right adjoints; uniqueness of left adjoints gives the level comparison for tower inverse image. Finite-level inverse image preserves finite limits by lem-sp-level-pullback-exact. Exact, jointly faithful evaluations reflect isomorphisms and finite limits, so the tower inverse image preserves finite limits. It preserves colimits as a left adjoint.

Apply the existing natural theorem sp_tower_derived_direct_image_evaluation from det-sp-tower-injective-components, which implements the unit proof: exact right extensions yield injective-product embeddings, injective towers are retracts of those products, their levels are acyclic, and evaluated bounded-below injective resolutions compute finite-level derived direct image. Thus the unit statement and all three resolution steps remain in the dependency proof. Convert the right-derived evaluations to mapDerivedCategoryPlus using exact-functor comparison isomorphisms and evaluate the resulting natural isomorphism at C.
